title: Breaking User-Centric Agency: A Tri-Party Framework for Agent-Based Recommendation
abstract: arXiv:2603.10673v3 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Large language models (LLMs) have spurred interest in agent-based recommender systems, yet most agentic approaches remain user-centric: items stay passive entities whose exposure is a by-product of relevance ranking, which exacerbates exposure concentration and long-tail under-representation. We break this user-centric allocation of agency with a Tri-party LLM-agent Recommendation framework (TriRec). Responsibility is split deliberately: Stage 1 has each item generate self-promotion conditioned on the target user, which lowers cold-start barriers, while the exposure budget stays with the platform, whose Stage 2 sequential re-ranker balances relevance, item utility, and exposure fairness. On four public datasets TriRec improves accuracy, fairness, and item-level utility, with the accuracy gain significant on three of the four. translated_title: 打破以用户为中心的代理机制：一种基于智能体的三方推荐框架
translated_abstract: 大型语言模型（LLMs）激发了人们对基于智能体的推荐系统的兴趣，但大多数智能体方法仍以用户为中心：物品保持被动实体状态，其曝光只是相关性排序的副产品，这加剧了曝光集中和长尾物品代表性不足的问题。我们通过一个三方LLM智能体推荐框架（TriRec）打破了这种以用户为中心的代理分配方式。责任被刻意划分：第一阶段，每个物品根据目标用户生成自我推广内容，降低了冷启动障碍，而曝光预算则保留在平台手中，其第二阶段顺序重排序器平衡了相关性、物品效用和曝光公平性。在四个公开数据集上，TriRec提高了准确性、公平性和物品级效用，其中四个数据集中的三个准确性提升显著。一项针对50个候选的三臂消融实验，在未获得曝光的物品上分离了该机制的两个层面。
tldr: 本文提出TriRec三方智能体推荐框架，通过让物品自主生成推广内容和平台控制曝光预算，同时提升推荐准确性、公平性与长尾物品效用。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes TriRec, a tri-party agent-based recommendation framework that empowers items to self-promote while the platform controls exposure budgets, jointly improving accuracy, fairness, and long-tail item utility.
